english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being alone or unaccompanied, especially when no companion or instructor is present.
Use this when the emphasis is on being alone or not accompanied by anything else, rather than merely being one in number.

examples.english: I went solo on the trip.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

examples.english: I want to take a single-person trip this time.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 soeng2 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
